additions.name: Motion Forcing
additions.title: Motion Forcing: A Decoupled Framework for Robust Video Generation in Motion Dynamics
alternateTitles: Motion Forcing: Decoupling Ego and Object Motion via Sparse Inputs for Structured Video Generation
additions.codeNote: Inference code, Gradio demo and checkpoint are released; data processing and training code remain marked coming soon.
additions.summary: Converts sparse object trajectories and camera motion into dynamic depth before rendering RGB video. Masked trajectory recovery supports motion completion; driving evaluation includes controlled traffic interactions.

additions.name: AutoAgent0
additions.title: AutoAgent0: An Agentic Runtime for Safe Closed-Loop Driving
additions.codeScope: Runtime implementation, checkpoints and CARLA evaluation
additions.codeNote: Public runtime modules, adapters, configurations and evaluation scripts; quickstart documents checkpoints and Fail2Drive evaluation. This is test-time recovery without retraining the underlying policies.
additions.summary: Wraps driving experts with independent scene assessment, rule-based trajectory verification and feedback-driven recovery planning, iteratively refining action primitives when nominal plans fail.

evidence.supports: Exact title, authors, v1 date, benchmarks and no-retraining runtime formulation.
Official project links the paper and code repository.
Installation, checkpoints, runtime configurations and evaluation commands are public.
